decision: The46.38758 GiB projection is conservative for the pinned229 unique complete training inputs and current six-leaf layout. It does not warrant a live quota/restart change. Continue monitoring actual stored_bytes and filesystem free space.

formula.input_tokens: T = len(prepared input_ids) - 1; supervised_hidden passes tokens[:, :-1] without truncation.
formula.kv3_bytes: T*ceil(T/64) = U8 candidate mask over ceil(T/8) blocks, packed8 per byte
formula.metadata_allowance: sum(32*T +131072); twice the per-entry non-tensor reservation terms16*T+65536. This is an allowance, not measured aggregate overhead.

source_reasoning: Cache is written after frozen block38 before trainable block39; persisted state is h, pre and all four shared attention leaves, not all39 layers.
Last KV source and candidate source are layer20, ratio1; the shared latent/index-key lengths areT and candidate width isceil(T/64). Subsequent index selection width ismin(512,T).
BF16 h/shared floating leaves and FP32 premix agree with allfive actual captured entries and dtype-preserving source construction; no new model evaluation was performed.

Cache identity includes exact complete input bytes, batch shape, training and checkpoint modes. Two fixed epochs over229 unique inputs reuse the same training-mode keys; adapter updates are strictly after the frozen boundary.
Disk quota counts file logical sizes, including binding/receipts and atomic staging. It raises on overflow and never evicts disk entries; RAM LRU eviction is a separate tier.

put reserves tensor bytes+16*T+65536 and checks serialized size within reservation; observed state.safetensors headers add470–488bytes. Entry JSON and binding files are additional and covered only by the declared metadata allowance.
limits: This is CPU arithmetic/source verification and captured metadata comparison, not independent remote full receipt/payload rehash or a full229-entry allocation measurement. Original remote entry hashes are recorded in the capture, but raw remote receipts were not reread by this reviewer.
No RAM/peak-memory, disk I/O latency, cache-hit speedup or training completion guarantee follows from the capacity estimate.

Additional modes, altered token sequences, changed boundary/config/dtype or other entries sharing the directory need separate accounting. Current train specification has empty validation, eval_steps459 beyond458 and final_fit_examples0.
Logical quota is not physical filesystem allocation or free disk; retain actual filesystem headroom and existing runtime guards.
The conservative metadata allowance is not a mathematical bound on arbitrary future receipt schemas or bindings. Current approximately17.61 GiB quota margin is large relative to inspected metadata.
